name: Inside The Mind of Daniel Johns
original_name: Inside The Mind of Daniel Johns
overview: Former Silverchair frontman Daniel Johns candidly recounts his mental-health collapse, substance use, legal fallout from a drink-driving crash, fractured band relationships, and the creative rebirth behind his solo project FutureNever in this three-part YouTube docuseries.
